query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "tua-bench: a benchmark for general-purpose terminal-use agents" computer science
rationale: The paper focuses on the influence of personality traits (OCEAN model) on LLM agent decision-making and planning, which is a distinct construct from the user's question regarding terminal-use agents and the TUA-Bench benchmark. It does not measure terminal interaction mechanisms, command-line environments, or the specific evaluation framework of TUA-Bench, failing to satisfy any of the inclusion criteria (a-f) for a literature review on this specific topic.
